decisions.quote:
We also successfully reproduce Cohen
   and Dechezleprêtre (2022)’s main results (Table 2 and Figure 2) using their code.
   We uncover one minor coding error where the authors accidentally exclude data
   from February 29th in leap years. Correcting the coding error does not significantly
   alter any of the main results in the analysis.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly obtain the original paper's reported Table 2 and Figure 2 numbers using the original code, and the minor leap-year coding bug they subsequently correct has only a trivial, non-substantive effect on the estimates.
